Certainty.description: Epistemic status of a memory. Ordered weakest first.
Certainty.title: Certainty

CompactionSummary.description:
A derived representation of turns `[0, through_turn)`. The turns stay in the run log.

The action ledger (every tool call, its outcome and artifact) is not stored here: it is
rebuilt from the run's events whenever the summary is rendered, so it can never be eroded
by repeated summarization.
CompactionSummary.title: CompactionSummary

ContextPolicy.description: How a run's context is budgeted and maintained. Persisted in RunCreated.
ContextPolicy.title: ContextPolicy

DeploymentInput.description: A gateway catalog entry (same schema as `[[deployments]]` in hollis.toml).
DeploymentInput.title: DeploymentInput

MemoryAccess.description: Namespaces a run may use. Every write namespace must also be readable.
MemoryAccess.title: MemoryAccess

RunBudget.description: Configured limits for one run. Persisted in RunCreated so recovery enforces the same.
RunBudget.title: RunBudget

RunPhase.description: Run status as shown to users (the runtime's statuses, simplified).
RunPhase.title: RunPhase

SourceTrust.description: Set by the operator who ingests a source; never by the source itself.
SourceTrust.title: SourceTrust

SummaryItem.description:
One note in a compaction summary. Immutable once recorded: a later compaction may resolve
it (with a reason) or add a new item, but never rewrites it.
SummaryItem.title: SummaryItem

post.description: Start a run in the background. Follow it with /stream (SSE) or /summary?wait_s=.

Approve or deny one pending tool call, as the authenticated principal. Invocation ids
contain slashes (`<run>/turn/<n>/call/<i>`) and are used verbatim in the path.

schema.title: Response Run Events V1 Runs  Run Id  Events Get

get.description:
Server-Sent Events: `run_event` events (id = event sequence) until the run finishes,
then one `end` event with the run summary. Comments keep idle connections alive.

With wait_s > 0, waits (long polling) until nothing drives the run any more: it
finished, waits for approval or stopped.
